account_deletion_open.name: account_deletion_open
account_deletion_open.where: "account_deletion_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "account_deletion_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "account_deletion_requests"."deleted_at" IS NULL

users_firebase_uid_live.name: users_firebase_uid_live
users_firebase_uid_live.where: "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "users"."firebase_uid" IS NOT NULL

users_phone_live.name: users_phone_live
users_phone_live.where: "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL

users_provider_adult.name: users_provider_adult
users_provider_adult.value: "users"."role" <> 'provider' OR "users"."date_of_birth" IS NULL OR "users"."date_of_birth" <= ("users"."created_at" - interval '18 years')::date
